decisions.reason: As the flagship transactional email service shown on the home page, it is a high-potential option in a growing cloud market whose value is still unfolding, so the firm should keep investing in it.
Document capture has its own page and fits the firm's electronic document workflows, so its uncertain but promising value justifies keeping it open at moderate cost.
Email and fax conversion runs on existing messaging infrastructure, so keeping it costs little, and it serves regulated customers who still rely on fax.
Fax delivery optimization is a cheap add-on to the core fax business with low carrying cost, so there is little reason to abandon it after only one year.
Sandbox threat protection addresses growing security demand and complements the email security suite, so keeping the option open is worthwhile while its uptake is uncertain.
Multi-engine virus scanning is an integrated, low-cost security feature that strengthens the compliance offering, so dropping it would release few resources.
